# Mohit Rajput — Front-End Developer with Salesforce Expertise

> Portfolio of Mohit Rajput, a front-end developer with Salesforce expertise and 5+ years of experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC), OmniStudio, Experience Cloud and Marketing Cloud solutions at Wipro and Mphasis Silverline. Nine Salesforce certifications, five Trailhead superbadges, Triple Star Ranger. Open to opportunities worldwide (remote, hybrid or onsite).

## Pages

- [Home](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/): Introduction, impact numbers, skills overview, client projects, professional journey, certificates, Trailhead status, live GitHub activity, articles and contact.
- [Projects](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/projects): Client projects delivered at Wipro and Mphasis Silverline (Ericsson, St. James's Place, American Honda, Republic Finance, Arvest Bank, Teladoc and more), plus live GitHub contribution heatmap and activity.
- Each client has its own page, for example [Ericsson](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/projects/ericsson) and [American Honda](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/projects/american-honda), with the role, stack and delivery highlights.
- [Experience](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/experience): Year-by-year career timeline at Wipro, Mphasis Silverline, DJT Corporation, Escade Technologies and Forelsket Softwares, plus education: MCA (distance learning) from Arunachal University of Studies and BCA from Gagan College of Management and Technology, affiliated to Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra.
- [Skills](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/skills): Salesforce, front-end, design-to-code, Marketing Cloud and DevOps toolkit.
- [Achievements](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/achievements): Nine Salesforce certifications and five more certificates (Udemy, freeCodeCamp, Internshala Trainings, Forelsket Softwares internship) with the originals, five Trailhead superbadges, Trailhead rank and awards.
- [Articles](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/blog): Articles on Experience Cloud performance, SLDS 2, Marketing Cloud and personalization.
- Each article has a summary page, for example [3.2 Seconds](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/blog/3-2-seconds), linking to the full text on LinkedIn.
- [Contact](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/contact): Contact form, social profiles and frequently asked questions.
- [Resume](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/resume): Embedded résumé with download.
- [Privacy & analytics](https://mohitveer.netlify.app/privacy): What lightweight, first-party usage analytics are collected, and how to opt out.
